evals.prompt: In apps/mobile/app/(main)/_layout.tsx, migrate the NativeWind className styles in the bottom tab navigation and current playing bar to StyleSheet.create. Preserve the existing visual layout and use agent-device to compare portrait and landscape before/after screenshots on Android dev.
evals.expected_output: A minimal StyleSheet migration that preserves tab spacing, current-playing interaction grouping, safe-area behavior, and includes before/after screenshot evidence.

evals.prompt: The React Native tab labels look too far away from their icons after a className-to-StyleSheet migration. Diagnose and fix the styling regression without redesigning the tab bar. Verify with device snapshots.
evals.expected_output: The response should identify lineHeight/text box migration as a likely cause, apply a targeted fix, and verify with a coordinate snapshot or screenshot.

evals.prompt: After moving an Expo side navigation rail from NativeWind to plain StyleSheet, Android landscape has a safe-area/rail offset bug while portrait is fine. Fix the layout and prove that both orientations still work.
evals.expected_output: The response should inspect breakpoint and safe-area logic, keep portrait behavior intact, and provide landscape plus portrait verification evidence.
